Install

Install on Android in three steps

Open Google Play

Tap the button on this page to open the official Vantro listing.

Tap Install

The app downloads and installs automatically.

Log in

Use your Vantro account and turn on fingerprint log-in under Account.

Questions before you join

Is there an APK download?

No. In Australia the Vantro app is only available from Google Play.

Which phones are supported?

Android phones with Android 8.0 or later.

How do updates work?

Google Play updates the app automatically if auto-update is on.

Can I use my existing account?

Yes. Log in with the account you opened on the website, or create one in the app.
